title: The Standard
summary: The shard is a spark, cut out of one of the bound, and near the bound a spark stirs them. The robed men dug down to the Third Legion under the Sunken Chapel. Sister Ilse wants its lamp broken, and the legion laid down.

steps.journal: Go down to the Binding Crypt, the Sunken Chapel's third floor, where the legion was bound, and break the Standard of the Third Legion in its last hall.

objectives.label: The Standard of the Third Legion

ready: The Standard's lamp is broken, and the legion lay down where it stood. Tell Sister Ilse at the Shrine of the Ember.
done: The Third Legion lay down, and the barrows road is open. Sister Ilse wrote it all down. Act I is done.
